t: You're looking at a marble statue of William Huskisson, standing in Pimlico Gardens, a small park in Pimlico. Huskisson was a British statesman and financier, and sat as a Member of Parliament for several constituencies, including Liverpool. The sculptor was John Gibson, a Welsh neoclassical artist who studied in Rome under Canova. Gibson is famous for his statues of Huskisson, Sir Robert Peel and Queen Victoria. The statue is listed Grade II on the National Heritage List for England, which was confirmed in January 2016.
